families.name: Breath as anchor
families.meaning: Points the listener back to the breath as the object of attention, returning them when the mind wanders.

families.name: Breathing instructions
families.meaning: Narrates the mechanics of inhaling and exhaling so the listener can follow the rhythm step by step.

families.name: Inhale-exhale cue
families.meaning: Pairs each in-breath and out-breath with an intention or self-talk line, guiding the listener through a set phrase.
members: breathing in i calm my body

families.name: Breath first person
families.meaning: Puts the breath in the first person so the listener speaks or feels it as their own.

families.name: Breath rhythm and motion
families.meaning: Describes the natural movement of breath, such as its rising, falling, and coming and going.

families.name: Nose or mouth route
families.meaning: Specifies the path the breath takes in and out of the body.

families.name: Settle and prepare
families.meaning: Invites the listener to get physically ready and settle into the practice before going further.

families.name: Eyes open or closed
families.meaning: Tells the listener when to close or open their eyes to mark the start and end of the session.

families.name: Attention awareness
families.meaning: Directs the listener to notice and become aware of their attention, body, or sensations.

families.name: Returning attention
families.meaning: Brings the listener's wandering attention back to the present moment or the practice.

families.name: Permission to be
families.meaning: Reassures the listener that nothing needs to be done, fixed, or perfect.

families.name: Body and mind unity
families.meaning: Names body and mind together to frame the session as a whole-person practice.

families.name: Brief and repeat
families.meaning: Frames the practice as short or repeated, asking the listener to repeat a process several times.

families.name: Grounding countdown
families.meaning: Counts down to bring the listener into the present through the senses.

families.name: Trial invitation
families.meaning: Softly invites the listener to test a suggestion and notice what happens.
